name: Finseo
description:
Finseo shows you how visible your brand is in AI search. Track your brand across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and more Models.

See how often you are mentioned, where you appear in the answer, and how positively you are described. Compare yourself against competitors, find out which websites and sources AI trusts most in your industry, and see which of your tracked questions perform best and where the gaps are. Everything updates every day, so you can follow how your visibility changes over time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Finseo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Finseo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.finseo.ai/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Finseo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finseo provides these MCP tools: get_competitor_ranking, get_query_fanouts, get_tags, get_top_sources, get_visibility_metrics, get_visibility_timeseries, list_projects, and list_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Finseo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Finseo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Finseo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Finseo is developed by Finseo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
